name: shopify
title: Shopify
description: Checkout events, order value and customer identity from Shopify Web Pixels. Composes with the official @datadog/browser-rum-shopify plugin rather than replacing it.

platforms.name: Shopify
platforms.notes: Custom pixel under Settings > Customer events. Requires the official shopifyPlugin alongside it for the sandbox fixes, views and clicks.

howItWorks.summary: In a Shopify custom pixel it runs next to the official shopifyPlugin and subscribes to the Web Pixels standard events. Installed anywhere else (a theme, a tag manager, an injector) it runs storefront mode instead: browsing events from the theme's own data, and cart changes from cart.js.

steps.title: Reads the storefront and its consent API
steps.detail: At init it reads `window.Shopify` for the shop, currency and locale, which become session context. It also asks Shopify's Customer Privacy API whether analytics is allowed: the answer is recorded on the page, so denied holds this plugin's events and every other community plugin's, but it never calls `setTrackingConsent`. Absent (inside the pixel sandbox) records nothing and defers to the consent Shopify already applied.

steps.title: Subscribes to Web Pixels events
steps.detail: It calls `analytics` `.subscribe` once for each of `collection_viewed`, `product_viewed`, `product_added_to_cart`, `product_removed_from_cart`, `cart_viewed`, `checkout_started`, `checkout_shipping_info_submitted`, `payment_info_submitted`, `checkout_completed` and `search_submitted`. `analytics` is the object Shopify hands a custom pixel; each event is mapped to one commerce action.

steps.title: Leaves the official plugin's events alone
steps.detail: `page_viewed`, `clicked` and `ui_extension_errored` are not subscribed: the official shopifyPlugin already binds those, and also patches the pixel sandbox so the SDK can run. The two compose rather than overlap.

steps.title: Identifies at checkout, and counts each order once
steps.detail: On `checkout_completed` it calls `setUser` with the Shopify customer ID before sending the purchase. The core records each order ID in `dd_rum_commerce_seen` in localStorage for 24 hours, so a reloaded thank-you page is not counted twice.

steps.title: Storefront mode: browsing, from the theme
steps.detail: With no `analytics` passed it reads `window.ShopifyAnalytics`, the `meta` object every Online Store theme prints: `view_item` on a product page, `view_item_list` on a collection, the length of the search query, and the signed-in customer ID for `setUser`. A `click` on a checkout control sends `begin_checkout`, valued from the cart. No form field is read.

steps.title: Storefront mode: cart changes, from cart.js
steps.detail: It watches resource timing for the theme's own requests to `cart.js` and the cart endpoints, then reads `cart.js` once itself and diffs it against the last snapshot, kept in `sessionStorage` as `dd_rum_shopify_cart`. That yields `add_to_cart` and `remove_from_cart` however the theme changed the cart, without patching `fetch` or XHR. Cart attributes, the note, line properties and the cart key are never read. Payment and the order stay pixel-only.

options.name: analytics
options.description: The sandbox analytics global from a custom pixel, the same object the official plugin takes as shopifyAnalytics. Without it the plugin runs storefront mode.

options.name: mode
options.description: pixel subscribes to analytics; storefront reads the theme (ShopifyAnalytics and cart.js); auto picks pixel when analytics is passed.

options.name: events
options.description: Allow-list of commerce actions. Every action in the schema by default.

options.name: identifyUsers
options.description: Call setUser with the Shopify customer ID from checkout_completed.

options.name: includeEmail
options.description: Add the checkout email to setUser.

options.name: includeName
options.description: Add the customer name to setUser.

options.name: actionPrefix
options.description: Rename the action prefix if the store has its own convention.

options.name: consent
options.description: auto reads the Shopify Customer Privacy API, ignore defers to the host page.

options.name: beforeTrack
options.description: Edit or drop an event before it is sent.

options.name: debug
options.description: Log every mapped event to the console.
